title: Innistrad: Double Feature: card flavor text

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place, beset by werewolves, vampires, geists and stitchers.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel formerly worshipped on Innistrad, now gone after her unmaking.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel to whom the people of Innistrad pray; she battled Sorin and later tore free from her bindings to summon her Host of Herons.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who manipulates time; he helped search for and recover the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who raced to his grandfather's crypt and battled Sigarda.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, an ancient vampire awakened to be the groom in the Voldaren-Markov wedding.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Voldaren vampire lord whose grand wedding aimed to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

entities.name: Heida
entities.description: A warrior fighting the werewolf beasts through a long night.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought clues to the Moonsilver Key in Thraben.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker with her own loyal pack; she helped recover the Moonsilver Key and objected at the Voldaren-Markov wedding.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and ghost-slayer who dispatched spirits in Thraben and saved Berit's village.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The long-lost key to the Celestus's Sungold Lock, needed to restore the day-night balance.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: A mechanism governing the balance of day and night, at the center of the witches' ritual.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: Part of the Celestus mechanism, which must be reunited with the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A cathar of the Order of Saint Traft who fought monsters for a lifetime and was doomed to become a vampire.

entities.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
entities.description: A cathar leader vowing to cleanse Thraben for the living.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A cunning werewolf leader whose howlpack terrorizes villages and whose howl commands even Arlinn's pack.

entities.name: Tovolar's howlpack
entities.description: Tovolar's werewolf pack, growing bolder, smarter and stronger.

entities.name: Dire-Strain
entities.description: Werewolves who kept hunting after Tovolar's howlpack scattered.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city of Innistrad whose districts lie in ruins and are patrolled by cathars.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A province of Innistrad with narrow ravines, festivals and effigy burnings.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A province of Innistrad.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A stormy province of Innistrad whose people rekindled their will to fight at dawn.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A coastal province with chaotic tides and violent storms.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Forest of Innistrad where old powers stirred.

entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: A forest where unseen threats lurk above travelers.

entities.name: Lurenbraum Fortress
entities.description: Olivia's fortress, site of the wedding, protected by a barrier passable with red invitations.

entities.name: Crimson Ballroom
entities.description: A ballroom in Lurenbraum Fortress that received unexpected guests.

entities.name: Markov catacombs
entities.description: Catacombs from which the Moonsilver Key was recovered.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Holy warriors of Innistrad who defend villages against monsters.

entities.name: Parish-Blades
entities.description: Elite cathars trained to delay and frustrate beasts hunting the crossways.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: A cathar order to which Odric and Grete belong.

entities.name: Quiver of Kessig
entities.description: An order of cathars specializing in ranged combat.

entities.name: Dawnhart witches
entities.description: A coven focusing magic on nature and community, who worship Ghrin-Danu.

entities.name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
entities.description: Leader of the Dawnhart witches, who warns that the land is sending a warning.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: A power revered by the Dawnhart witches who has not abandoned them.

entities.name: Skirsdag cult
entities.description: A demon-worshipping cult that turned to Ormendahl after Griselbrand's defeat.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon worshipped by the Skirsdag cult, offering power at a price.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A defeated demon formerly worshipped by the Skirsdag cult.

entities.name: Jerren
entities.description: A faithful servant of Ormendahl.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: An ascendant vampire bloodline demanding blood tithes from villagers.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline descended from a vicious falconer.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire bloodline, some of whom borrow from the blood tithes.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A Falkenrath vampire.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A Stromkirk vampire who warns alchemists on behalf of Lord Krothuss.

entities.name: Lord Krothuss
entities.description: A figure guarding the secrets of the sea.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A ghoulcaller who commands zombies and competes with her brother.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher whose prowess continues to grow; Gisa's brother.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist who keeps laboratory notes.

entities.name: Garl
entities.description: A stitcher's assistant working for Ludevic.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: Past dark times featuring killer angels, mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: A festival on Innistrad, the site of a tragedy when werewolves struck.

entities.name: Voldaren-Markov wedding
entities.description: Olivia Voldaren's wedding to Edgar Markov, the event of the century.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: The rest given to the dead.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrosities fought during the Travails.

entities.name: Host of Herons
entities.description: Sigarda's angelic host.

entities.name: Berit
entities.description: A villager who became a vampire slayer after Kaya saved her village.

entities.name: Silverstreak
entities.description: A gryff who lost her rider but still helps humankind.

entities.name: Geor
entities.description: A Havengul fisher.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: An inventor whose device reveals geists.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A Kessig ranger.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A Kessig trapper who travels with Halana.

entities.name: Verna
entities.description: A priest of Sigarda.

entities.name: Vildin-Pack
entities.description: A werewolf pack led by Rahilda.

entities.name: Rahilda
entities.description: Alpha of the Vildin-Pack.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A speaker on the forests of Innistrad.

entities.name: Quietus Cult
entities.description: A cult that seeks wisdom from the dead rather than demons.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: A town whose cobbled streets echoed with howls.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A burning chasm where ancient evils dwell.

events.summary: Teferi steps into a fight and freezes time around attacking werewolves.
events.quote: Teferi stepped calmly into the fray. Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

events.summary: Sorin races to his grandfather's resting-crypt but finds someone got there first.
events.quote: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

events.summary: Heida fells a beast and seeks another foe.
events.quote: Heida allowed herself a moment of satisfaction as she watched the beast fall, then turned to seek another foe.

events.summary: Chandra, Teferi and Arlinn search for clues to the Moonsilver Key while Kaya dispatches spirits.
events.quote: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

events.summary: While Sigarda and Sorin battle, Arlinn and Teferi recover the key from the Markov catacombs.
events.quote: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

events.summary: Tovolar's howl sounds and is answered from within the Harvesttide festival.
events.quote: When Tovolar's howl sounded from the woods, it was answered from the heart of the festival.

events.summary: Tovolar joins the battle and cathars fall.
events.quote: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

events.summary: Tovolar's howl of command turns Arlinn's own loyal pack.
events.quote: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

events.summary: Witches, werewolves and cathars defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
events.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

events.summary: The Dawnhart witches lash out at the werewolves after their ritual is disrupted.
events.quote: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

events.summary: Bats carry wedding invitations from Lurenbraum Fortress to every bloodline.
events.quote: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

events.summary: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda breaks her bindings and summons the Host of Herons.
events.quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

events.summary: Kaya saves Berit's village, inspiring Berit to become a vampire slayer.
events.quote: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed.

events.summary: Odric succumbs to a vampire's curse and becomes a monster.
events.quote: But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

events.summary: Arlinn interrupts the Voldaren-Markov wedding before the officiant can ask for objections.
events.quote: Before the officiant even had a chance to ask if anyone objected to the Voldaren-Markov union, Arlinn made her opinion known.

events.summary: The defenses of Lurenbraum Fortress falter and the Crimson Ballroom is invaded.
events.quote: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

events.summary: Dawn returns to Stensia after weeks of darkness.
events.quote: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

events.summary: Tovolar's howlpack scatters, but Dire-Strain survivors keep hunting.
events.quote: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.
